**Finding: compliant (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

The APCN 2 Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements-sourcing obligation on Teleglobe USA Inc. I checked every responsive location:

- **p0262 (Para 27.1)** — the only "exclusive" hit is "sole and exclusive remedy" in the dispute-resolution procedure. That is a remedies limitation, not a sourcing restriction, and belongs under the remedies/governing-law rule rather than EXCLUSIVITY.
- **p0206 / p0208 (Paras 12.20, 12.22)** — expressly entitle each Party to sell IRUs and make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions"; these run in our favour.
- **p0225–p0227 (Paras 17.2–17.4)** — require reasonable, non-discriminatory access arrangements and prohibit Terminal Parties from impeding Direct Access; again in our favour and not flagged.
- Targeted searches for purchase/procure covenants, "all of its requirements", third-party restrictions, and non-compete/restrict language surfaced nothing binding us.

Because the preferred element ("Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation") is already satisfied on the document's own terms, no operative change is warranted and I have not proposed one.
